episode_title: 96. 3 Bonus Ways to Generate Leads on LinkedIn Without Cold Outreach
question: How do you generate leads from LinkedIn group polls without cold outreach?
transcript_excerpt: By joining relevant LinkedIn groups like Sales Management Executives, conduct one business-specific poll per week asking about key challenges. Click on the vote counts to see every person who voted, review their profile headlines to identify ideal clients or business allies, then right-click and send personalized connection requests mentioning the specific poll they voted in. For example, a poll asking about the biggest disconnect between sales strategy and team execution generated 190 votes, allowing you to filter voters by their fit to your business.

episode_title: 96. 3 Bonus Ways to Generate Leads on LinkedIn Without Cold Outreach
question: What are the three bonus ways to generate leads on LinkedIn without cold outreach?
transcript_excerpt: The first is leveraging LinkedIn polls in groups to connect with engaged voters who fit your ideal client or business ally persona. The second is reaching out to your LinkedIn newsletter subscribers who are not yet first-degree connections by reviewing their headlines and sending personalized connection requests. The third is messaging your existing first-degree connections who voted in your personal LinkedIn polls, thanking them for voting and offering to support each other.

episode_title: 96. 3 Bonus Ways to Generate Leads on LinkedIn Without Cold Outreach
question: How can you identify and message warm leads from LinkedIn poll voters on your personal profile?
transcript_excerpt: When conducting a poll on your personal profile, voters who are your first-degree connections display a blue arrow icon pointing up to the right. Clicking this icon opens your LinkedIn DMs with the poll post included. You can then message them directly thanking them for voting and offering support, which is the warmest lead generation opportunity because they are already a connection and you are referencing an existing touchpoint.

episode_title: 96. 3 Bonus Ways to Generate Leads on LinkedIn Without Cold Outreach
question: How do you convert LinkedIn newsletter subscribers into leads outside your current connections?
transcript_excerpt: LinkedIn newsletter subscribers represent a separate audience layer from your first-degree connections and followers. Review the subscriber list (which shows headline information), filter for those matching your ideal client or business ally persona, right-click to open their profile, send a connection request, and add a personalized note thanking them for subscribing and expressing interest in connecting.
